description: This Java class 'ContentKeywordIndex' handles indexing of content for keyword search, gathering data from various related entities and storing keywords with relevancy weights.

classes.name: ContentKeywordIndex
classes.description: A utility class for indexing content for keyword search, including methods for gathering data, processing keywords, and storing them.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Forces reindexing of keywords for a given content.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Indexes keywords for a given content, with optional full reindex.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method that performs indexing, gathering data from various related entities and processing keywords.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Adds content text from a data resource to the index with specified weight.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a string field from a GenericValue to the list of strings for indexing, with default weight.
